title: LASH: Adaptive Semantic Hybridization for Black-Box Jailbreaking of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on a black-box jailbreaking framework (LASH) intended for red-teaming Large Language Models. While it evaluates success against various harm categories (like fraud, harassment, and government decision-making), it does not specifically benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or formal moral/ethical systems.
